description: List SPANISH government tenders filtered by lifecycle status on PLACSP (Spain public procurement / licitaciones, contrataciondelestado.es official feed): PUB = published and open for bids, PRE = prior information notice (anuncio previo), EV = under evaluation, ADJ = awarded (adjudicada), RES = resolved / award finalized, ANUL = cancelled. Ideal for "currently open Spanish tenders" (status PUB) or "recently awarded Spanish government contracts" (ADJ or RES). Returns compact shaped notices with title, contracting body, EUR budget amounts, CPV codes, contract type, procedure, submission deadline, and notice URL.

status.description: Status code: PUB | PRE | EV | ADJ | RES | ANUL.
